subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Rhodium cod dppe cation（[Rh(cod)(dppe)]⁺）？
A. Square planar
B. Tetrahedral
C. Linear
D. Trigonal bipyramidal
explanation: Square planar. Covalent count: Rh (group 9) 9 e; 1 × cod (L₂) 4 e; 1 × dppe (L₂) 4 e; the 1+ charge removes 1 e: 16 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry no charge and the complex has a 1+ charge, so the metal is Rh(I), d⁸; d⁸ + 8 e from the ligands = 16 e. A precursor for asymmetric hydrogenation when dppe is replaced by a chiral diphosphine.
